name: Double Seat Quad - Boundary Area
blurb: Take a passenger. Same marked boundary area, a larger engine to carry two.

durations.label: 30 minutes
durations.blurb: The lowest commitment. Enough to learn the controls and cross a few dune faces on the Double Seat Boundary.

durations.label: 1 hour
durations.blurb: The sweet spot for most riders. Time to settle into the Double Seat Boundary and get a proper run at the red dunes.

durations.label: 2 hours
durations.blurb: A longer route with more varied terrain and photo stops, for riders already comfortable on the Double Seat Boundary.

durations.label: 3 hours
durations.blurb: A half-day session. Suits confident riders and groups pairing the ride with a camp stop.

durations.label: 4 hours
durations.blurb: The longest route we run on the Double Seat Boundary. For experienced riders who want maximum time in the dunes.
